description: Checks whether an external page can be shown inside the live room's CTA area (sidebar or overlay): whether it sends the headers that allow embedding, and what would go wrong if it does not. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it BEFORE embedding a booking or checkout page into a CTA (that is wi_change_webinar_cta), because a page that refuses framing shows an empty box to the participants and no error to the host. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

url.description: The full address of the page that should be shown inside the room.
